policy.tsx.questionsAboutSiteUsagePrivac: For questions about site usage or privacy, contact the author by email or WeChat.
policy.tsx.siteProvidesIpLookupsNetworkD: This site provides IP lookups, network diagnostics, browser checks and service status queries.
policy.tsx.useTheseToolsTargetsAuthorize: Use these tools only for targets you are authorized to test. Do not use the site for unlawful activity, disrupting third-party services, bypassing access restrictions or abusing the API.
policy.tsx.resultsDependNetworkBrowserRe: Results depend on the network, browser restrictions and third-party data. They are for reference and do not guarantee security, account access or continued availability. Maintenance, rate limits or upstream failures may interrupt service.
policy.tsx.whenVisitingThirdPartyLinksUs: When visiting third-party links or using their services, follow their terms as well. Use of the source code is governed by the license in the repository.
policy.tsx.hostingServiceProcessesReques: The hosting service processes your request IP and necessary network request information. IP and domain queries and network tests send the relevant target to the selected data source or diagnostic service. Third-party sites contacted directly by your browser can also see that connection’s egress IP.
policy.tsx.browserDiagnosticsReadDisplay: Browser diagnostics read and display the environment, fingerprint or permission information needed by the selected checks. The consistency page automatically starts local deep diagnostics. Some network checks and optional CAPTCHA features contact third-party services.
policy.tsx.siteStoresThemeLanguageNotice: This site stores theme, language, notice preferences and lookup history in the current browser. Lookup history includes recent successful queries and results; queried addresses may also appear in browser history. You can clear local data through your browser’s site data settings.
policy.tsx.ipHealthQueriesSendQueriedPub: IP health queries send the queried public IP to Net.Coffee. Other queries, maps, site resources and verification features process necessary request data through their respective services. Third-party and hosting data processing and log retention depend on their policies and actual configuration.
policy.tsx.apiRequiresKeyButRateLimitedR: The API requires no key but is rate-limited by request IP. Reduce request frequency after a 429 response; do not rotate IPs to bypass limits. Cross-site browser calls are restricted.
policy.tsx.httpResponsesLatencyDifferIcm: HTTP responses and latency differ from ICMP ping and do not establish AI login, chat or model access. An egress IP describes the route of that request only. IP reputation and browser anomalies alone do not prove abuse or identity spoofing.
policy.tsx.featuresDataSourcesRateLimits: Features, data sources and rate limits may change. Check the current instructions before use and verify important results through the relevant official service.
policy.tsx.ipLookupsMayContactIpwhoIpSbI: IP lookups may contact ipwho.is, ipquery.io, IP.SB or ipify; IP health uses Net.Coffee. Global ping sends targets and probe selections to Globalping; maps prefer Tianditu and fall back to OpenStreetMap when it is not configured or unavailable; service status reads providers’ public endpoints. Requests depend on the pages and checks you select.
policy.tsx.webrtcChecksConnectGoogleClou: WebRTC checks connect to Google and Cloudflare STUN services and may reveal an egress address different from web requests. Camera, microphone and location tests start when clicked and are controlled by browser permissions. Media permission tests close the stream immediately without recording audio or video. Revoke permissions in browser settings.
policy.tsx.whenConfiguredUsedCaptchaFeat: When configured and used, CAPTCHA features load Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA. This site forwards verification tokens to the provider for validation. Those services also process device and network signals under their own policies.
policy.tsx.lookupHistoryKeepsLatest10Suc: Lookup history keeps the latest 10 successful queries and results per category in the current browser; clear site data to remove it. The server uses request IPs for rate limiting. Hosting configuration enables sampled logs; actual records and retention depend on deployment settings. Clearing browser data does not remove third-party or hosting records. Contact the author with the request time and feature for data questions.
